title: Marker
look: Felt-tip marker on a whiteboard: a thick contour, streaky fills in four marker colours, ghosts of erased drawings.

doc.essence: A quick drawing in a meeting room: chisel-tip markers in black, blue, red and green, a bold contour, areas filled with side-by-side strokes that darken where they overlap, faint ghosts of what was wiped off before.
doc.notIt: Not crayon (smooth wet ink, streaks not wax, a white board), not line-art (thick line, coloured fills), not ink (four colours, streaky fills, boil).
doc.shapes: A thick black marker contour that wobbles slightly. Areas are filled with broad parallel strokes that leave thin darker seams.
doc.colour: Only four marker colours and the board's white. Light areas stay white.
doc.motion: On twos, with a small boil on the line.
pitfalls: Characters whose colours all snap to one marker read as one colour: the contour separates the parts.
Erased ghosts stay faint and away from the face.
